seoTitle: Pie and Donut Chart Maker with Percent Labels
metaDescription: Enter categories and values to get an SVG pie or donut chart with percentage labels, a legend and a data table. Free and private.
intro: Builds a pie or donut chart from category and value lines. Each slice shows its share of the total, and a legend lists the exact percentages.
why:
Pie charts work for a few parts of a whole and fail beyond that. This tool warns by design: it draws what you give it, labels each slice with its percentage, and supplies a table so the numbers are never only in the colours.

The donut option leaves room for a total or note when you place the SVG in a slide. Slices smaller than about 4 percent keep their value in the legend rather than crowding the chart. Negative values are rejected because they have no meaning in a pie.
howTo: Type one category and value per line, separated by a comma.
Set the hole size: 0 for a pie, about 55 for a donut.
Choose decimals and whether to sort the largest first.

faq.q: Why are tiny slices not labelled?
faq.a: Labels under 4 percent would overlap. The legend still shows every percentage.
Zero rows are dropped. Negative values give an error.
